messages.content: The La Jolla hotel is showing our room for $331 now instead of $356. Can you check whether it is truly the same room and what we'd save without touching Little Italy or the Monday move?

Yes. I’ll compare the exact room name, October 4-7 dates, occupancy, parking, taxes, and cancellation language against confirmation LJ730184. I’ll leave LI492706 and the split-stay sequence unchanged.
The listing just says the same category name. It doesn't make the $35 parking or refund deadline obvious.

The hotel has confirmed that the $331 offer is for the identical room category, one room for two adults, for all three nights from Friday, October 4 through Monday, October 7. The $35 nightly parking charge still applies. It is paid at the hotel and is not included in the displayed room rate.
What are the actual totals, including tax? The earlier La Jolla estimate was $1,178.40, so please reconcile that too.

The hotel’s itemized totals correct that earlier estimate. Existing reservation: $1,068 room subtotal, $135.64 lodging tax, and $105 parking, for $1,308.64. New rate: $993 room subtotal, $126.11 lodging tax, and $105 parking, for $1,224.11. The net savings would be $84.53. The prior $1,178.40 figure did not fully include both the confirmed tax and parking and should be replaced.
And is the cheaper one refundable on exactly the same terms? I don't want a prepaid rate that looks cheaper at first.

It is not prepaid. The lower rate permits cancellation without penalty through September 27 at 6:00 p.m. Pacific, matching LJ730184. After that cutoff, the penalty is one night plus tax. No deposit is due now; the room and parking are payable at the hotel.
So the only difference is $25 less per night, plus the related tax reduction?

Correct. The dates, room category, occupancy, parking arrangement, payment timing, and cancellation cutoff are the same. The $75 room-rate reduction lowers tax by $9.53, producing the $84.53 total savings.
That's enough to change it. Can it be done without risking the room?

Yes. The safer sequence is to reserve the $331 rate first, verify the new confirmation, and only then cancel LJ730184 while it remains refundable. This will not affect the Little Italy booking, Monday luggage storage, rental, or flights.
Do that sequence, and stop if the new confirmation shows anything different.

The replacement La Jolla reservation is confirmed as LJ731026 for October 4-7 at $1,224.11 including estimated tax and three nights of parking. It shows the same room category, no prepayment, and free cancellation through September 27 at 6:00 p.m. Pacific. I then canceled LJ730184; its cancellation confirmation shows a $0 penalty and no charge or deposit to refund.
Give me the revised lodging and trip totals, and confirm the rest of the split stay is intact.

The split stay remains intact: La Jolla October 4-7 under LJ731026, then Little Italy October 7-9 under LI492706, with Monday luggage storage still confirmed. Revised lodging is $1,949.71: $1,224.11 La Jolla plus $725.60 Little Italy. The trip projection is now $3,525.71 before checked bags: $1,142 airfare, $1,949.71 lodging, and $434 transportation. With the separate $140 checked-bag estimate, the projected total is $3,665.71. Charges posted so far remain $1,504.80 because the replacement La Jolla reservation required no deposit.
